### The Counterpoint
**Wall Street’s GPU Futures Push Stalls at the CFTC:** The Information
The Commodity Futures Trading Commission extended its review of proposed futures contracts on Nvidia GPU rental prices, delaying any launch past the targeted early October date and requiring broader industry comments on how the contracts would function.

Source: https://www.theinformation.com/articles/wall-streets-gpu-futures-push-stalls-cftc
sections.deep_dive:
### The Thread: AI tool launches and partnerships
Google and the Gates Foundation are directing $100 million to scale AI climate and crop tools that already reach 50 million smallholder farmers and will expand to 200 million across Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Those farmers produce nearly 35 percent of global food on more than 500 million farms. Microsoft is simultaneously authorizing 30-to-50 percent discounts on Copilot subscriptions tied to large seat commitments and usage-based payment
